keywords.description:
Keywords for search/command palette integration.
Useful for alternative names or search terms for the command.

action.description: The action to perform when the hotkey is triggered.

description.description: Description of what the command does

hotkey.description: The hotkey to trigger the command.

scopes.description: The scopes to use for the hotkey command.

preventDefault.description: Whether to prevent the default browser behavior.

stopPropagation.description: Whether to stop the event propagation

enableOnFormTags.description:
Whether to enable the hotkey on form tags.
- `true`: Enable on all form tags (input, textarea, select)
- `false`: Disable on all form tags (default)
- `FormTagName[]`: Enable only on specific form tag types

enableOnContentEditable.description: Whether to enable the hotkey on content editable elements.

capture.description: Use capture phase for event listeners (default: true)

requireReset.description:
When true, the hotkey fires only once per key press.
The key must be released before it can fire again.

eventType.description:
The event type to listen for.
- `"keydown"`: Fire when the key is pressed (default)
- `"keyup"`: Fire when the key is released

target.description:
Scope the command to a DOM subtree. The command only fires when the event
originates within this element. Accepts an element or a function returning
one, resolved on every event; while it resolves to `null`, the command is
skipped. The element must contain focus to receive keyboard events.
The target element to listen for hotkeys

defaultOptions.description: The default options to use for the store

sequenceTimeoutMs.description: The timeout in milliseconds for sequence completion

activeScopes.description: The active scopes when the store is created

conflictBehavior.description: How to handle conflicts when two commands register the same hotkey.

target.description: The target element to listen for key events

onRecord.description: Called when a hotkey is successfully recorded

onCancel.description: Called when recording is cancelled (via Escape)

onClear.description: Called when the recorded hotkey is cleared (via Backspace/Delete)

formatOptions.description: Options for formatting the display string

sequenceTimeoutMs.description:
Timeout in milliseconds to wait for the next sequence step.
If no key is pressed within this window, the recording finalizes.
